/* selectUserUnitSystem - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, (SELECT E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 E /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE E.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_SYS_SE_CD' AND E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_NM, C.OGDP_INST_NO, (SELECT F.INST_NM FROM SAA000 F /* 통합기관 */ WHERE F.INST_NO = C.OGDP_INST_NO) AS OGDP_INST_NM, C.OGDP_DEPT_CD, (SELECT G.DEPT_NM FROM SAA300 G /* 부서 */ WHERE G.INST_NO = C.OGDP_INST_NO AND G.DEPT_CD = C.OGDP_DEPT_CD) AS OGDP_DEPT_NM
FROM SCA140 C /* 종사자 수행 업무 */
WHERE C.ENFSN_NO = ( SELECT D.ENFSN_NO FROM SAA200 D /* 사용자 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} )
